info.title: API.SH: ASOS
info.description: The ASOS API from API.SH: public ASOS data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
ASOS's search-box suggestions for the start of a query, each with its number of results in the store.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/asos-autocomplete

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Start of a search.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Store (default US).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One ASOS product by id or link: name, brand, gender, product type, current/previous/RRP prices and lowest 30-day price, stock, description, size & fit, care and material notes, brand description, ratings (average, count, % recommended, distribution), images, catwalk video, every size/colour variant with SKU, EAN, availability and price, breadcrumbs and size guide link. `stock_by_size` lists each size with in-stock, low-in-stock and restocking-soon flags; variants also carry `restocking_soon` and `stock_updated_at`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/asos-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ASOS product id (the number after /prd/ in a product link), or pass `url`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An asos.com product (/prd/) link, instead of `id`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Store: US (default), GB, DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, AU, SE, DK, PL.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of an ASOS product, newest first by default: rating, title, text, ratings-only flag, recommended, nickname, date, language, colour bought, verified-purchase badge, the fit and quality sliders, syndication source, photos and videos. Also the average rating, star distribution, recommended share, the fit and quality averages and the site's review summary. Up to 50 a page (default 20). Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/asos-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ASOS product id (or an asos.com product link in `url`).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An asos.com product link with /prd/<id>.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Store (sets the review language shown first). Default US.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page, up to 50.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products on ASOS for keywords or a category, in one of 11 country stores (prices in the store's currency), with every filter the site offers: sort, brand, color, size, Sale/New Season, gender, discount band, new-in date and the product attributes listed in `facets` (pass a facet's `id` as the parameter name and value ids comma-separated, e.g. `attribute_1046=8310` for Straight Leg). Each product: id, name, brand, current/previous/RRP prices and the lowest price of the last 30 days, colour, product code, link, images and video. `total` is the site's count; 72 per page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. `price_min` and `price_max` limit the current price.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/asos-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords, e.g. `jeans`. Required unless `category` is given.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id (the `cid` in an asos.com /cat/?cid= link), e.g. `3630` for women's jeans.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Store: US (default), GB, DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, AU, SE, DK, PL.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, newest.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand ids from `facets` (brand), comma-separated, e.g. `53` for ASOS DESIGN.

parameters.name: base_colour
parameters.description: Color ids from `facets`, comma-separated.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size ids from `facets`, comma-separated.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: `sale` and/or `new_season`.

parameters.name: floor
parameters.description: Gender ids: 1000 women, 1001 men, 2001 unisex.

parameters.name: discount_band
parameters.description: Discount band ids from `facets`.

parameters.name: freshness_band
parameters.description: New-in ids from `facets` (1 today, 2 yesterday, 3 last 7 days...).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest current price, in the store's currency.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest current price, in the store's currency.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (max 72).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Live stock and price for up to 50 ASOS products in one call: in stock, current, previous and recommended price, lowest price in the last 30 days, currency, markdown and outlet flags, price start date, restocking flag and lead time, and every variant's stock (in stock, low in stock, restocking soon), price and stock update time. Variant ids match `variants` in /asos/v1/product (size and colour live there). `not_found` lists ids the store did not return.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/asos-stock

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: ASOS product ids or product links, comma separated (up to 50).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Store (prices in its currency). Default US.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
